abstract: This case report presents the findings of significantly large sized (> 8 cm) symptomatic unilateral cystic teratomas in two perimenopausal patients in remote Nepal. Ovarian dermoid cysts consist of cystic, solid and fat tissue. Traditionally, cells differentiate along the various germ lines, essentially recapitulating various body tissues. The characteristic sonographic features include a dermoid plug, dermoid mesh, a fat-fluid level and the "tip of the iceberg" sign. The presence of two or more of these typical features confidently supports an ultrasound-based diagnosis of ovarian dermoid cyst. The presence of intratumoral hair, teeth, fat, and skin tissue revealed at surgery confirmed the initial ultrasound based diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 本症例報告は、ネパール僻地の2名の更年期周辺期女性にみられた、症状を伴う8cmを超える大型の片側性嚢胞性奇形腫について報告するものである。卵巣類皮嚢腫の典型的な超音波所見として、類皮プラグ、類皮メッシュ、脂肪-液体レベル、「氷山の一角」徴候を挙げる。これらの典型所見のうち2つ以上が存在すると、超音波検査による診断を確実に支持する。手術で腫瘍内に毛髪、歯、脂肪、皮膚組織が認められ、超音波に基づく初期診断が確認された。
